title: cs-daily-scratchpad-lucas-reed-2026-05-10
content:
Daily scratchpad - quick reminders and action items for May 10, 2026

Top priorities for today:
- QBR prep: Lumina AI (2026-05-18) - finalize deck, confirm presenter (ask Samira to cover performance improvements).
- Renewal outreach: Octane Health - renewal due 2026-06-09 (30 days). Need commercial counter + exec sponsor reminder.
- Support follow-up: Atlas Retail ticket (CS-4122) - latency regression reported after recent model rollout. SRE assigned (Ryan) but need status update before EOD.

Accounts / notes:
1) Lumina AI (QBR)
   - QBR scheduled: 2026-05-18, 10:00 PT (confirmed).
   - Attendees: CSM (Nina), Solutions Eng (Samira), Product PM (client: Priya Desai), CTO (client: Marco Li).
   - Draft deck: use CONFLUENCE:QBR-template-2026 -> copy into deck and add Lumina usage slides (tokens/day, top routes, error rates).
   - Action: ask Solutions Eng to include short demo of new batching/kv-cache improvements (value prop: 18% cost reduction on inference). Deadline: 2026-05-13 (Samira).
   - Prep checklist: metrics exported, top 3 ask list from client, billing/forecast slide, proposed roadmap items.

2) Octane Health (renewal risk)
   - Renewal date: 2026-06-09. Current ARR seat: $120k/year.
   - Signals: lower usage last 2 months, support tickets about timeouts, finance unresponsive to renewal email.
   - Outreach plan:
     - Today: send personalized renewal check-in email + propose 30-min call next week. (Draft below)
     - If no response in 3 business days -> escalate to AM lead (Aisha) to loop in exec sponsor.
   - Draft renewal email (short):
     "Hi Marco - hope you’re well. Quick check-in as your Redwood renewal is coming up on June 9. I’d love to schedule a 20-30m sync next week to review usage, cost-optimization ideas (batching/quant profiles) and any outstanding support items. Are you free Tue/Thu mornings? - Lucas"

3) Atlas Retail (support)
   - Ticket JIRA: CS-4122 (latency regression after model variant rollout).
   - Impact: elevated P95 on production route "product-recs"; causing client-side timeouts.
   - Current owner: SRE (Ryan Cole). Support owner: me (Lucas).
   - Action: ping Ryan for timeline and ask for rollback window if needed. Also notify client of acknowledgment and ETA.

Quick todos (today):
- [ ] Finalize Lumina QBR deck (pull usage numbers) - assigned: Lucas / Nina - due 2026-05-13
- [ ] Email Octane renewal draft - assigned: Lucas - send today
- [ ] Check with Ryan on CS-4122 and confirm mitigation plan - assigned: Lucas - check-in by 3pm PT
- [ ] Update QBR agenda in Confluence page and attach deck link - assigned: Nina - due 2026-05-14
- [ ] Get Solutions Eng confirmation for demo slot in QBR (Samira) - ping now

Notes to self / scribbles:
- Ask billing to generate 90-day usage trend for Octane (linked_artifact: JIRA CS-4189 billing request).
- Consider offering Octane a 3-month price lock + free audit of batch configs if they express churn intent. Need legal ok? Loop Aisha.
- Template: reuse last Lumina deck layout (slides: KPI, Recent changes, Ops incidents, Roadmap, Recommendations).

Meeting log / quick timeline:
- 09:10 - Morning sync with Nina: aligned on metrics to include.
- 10:30 - Pinged Samira about demo.
- 11:00 - Called finance for Octane billing history (voicemail left).

Useful links / references:
- QBR template: CONFLUENCE:QBR-template-2026
- Octane health slack thread: slack:#cs-octane-health-thread
- Atlas Retail ticket: JIRA:CS-4122

Reminders for EOD:
- Send follow-up emails for any outstanding items (Octane, Samira, Ryan).
- Mark Lumina deck status as "in_review" in Confluence and notify attendees.
- Log any blocker in JIRA and tag product/engineering if more help needed.

Random ideas / backlog:
- Build a simple renewal-risk dashboard: combine renewal date, usage trend, open tickets, NPS signal. Could be a quick Looker board or a small internal notebook. (Add to backlog: proj-id CS-RENEW-001)

-- Lucas
